name: host-parallel-printer
description: Sends everything the BBC prints to a printer port on the host computer, such as /dev/usb/lp0 or LPT1.

parameters.label: Device
parameters.description: Host printer device: /dev/usb/lp0 or /dev/lp0 on Linux; on Windows a USB printer's \\?\usb#... interface path (HostParallelPrinter.ListDevices lists them) or LPTn, opened as \\.\LPTn

parameters.label: Buffer (bytes)
parameters.description: receiver queue depth in bytes; when it is full the BBC waits for /ACK

parameters.label: Reopen interval (ms)
parameters.description: milliseconds between attempts to open the device while it is not open; 0 makes one attempt and never retries
